thread.text: HackerRank has launched Chakra, an AI agent that conducts technical interviews and evaluates candidate reasoning in real time during coding tasks.
The system has already conducted over 500,000 interviews during testing with early participants like Snowflake and Capgemini.
Assessments focus on AI fluency and critical thinking rather than final output, aiming to combine multiple interview rounds into one.

Practice explaining your workflow on a mock coding problem and write down how you adapted your solution to new constraints.

Source: TechCrunch
